answer.provenance_hint: Checkrail also takes provenance: where the instruction to pay came from and where the payee, amount, payout details and reference came from (owner_chat, system_of_record, vendor_portal, email_internal, email_external, web, document, unknown). An instruction from an outside email or the web is held for a person, and payout details are never taken from an agent. It can only add holds: it never relaxes a rule.

counter_offer.how_to_answer: accept_offer(offer_id) puts a request at the offered amount in the business's inbox; it still goes through its rules and approval. dispute_offer(offer_id, reason, evidence) sends your reason and records to a person.
